basics.name: Ana M. Palacio-Castro
basics.label: Associate Scientist
basics.summary: Associate Scientist at CIMAS and NOAA AOML. I study how ocean warming, acidification, diseases, and land-based pollution affect corals and the coral-algal symbiosis, and which environmental and genetic factors enhance coral resilience. I combine field data, controlled experiments, and molecular techniques, and apply these findings to coral restoration and reef management.

education.thesis: Dissertation: Abiotic controls on endosymbiotic algal communities and their implications for coral bleaching susceptibility and recovery.
Thesis: Comparison of methods for monitoring sessile benthic communities in “La Azufrada”, coral reef, Gorgona Island National Natural Park.

work.name: UM-CIMAS, NOAA-AOML
highlights: Co-lead a multidisciplinary team of 15–18 members across Coral Program projects and provide strategic direction for project prioritization, planning, and execution
Lead and co-lead externally funded projects (NOAA, FDEP, NFWF, NATO, CORDAP), including budgeting, field work, and coordination across institutions
Oversee laboratory and field-based research on coral health, stress tolerance and restoration
Mentor Ph.D. students and postdoctoral researchers

work.name: UM-CIMAS, NOAA-AOML
highlights: Designed and conducted laboratory experiments on the physiological and molecular responses of corals to multiple stressors
Managed funded projects, including budgeting, planning, and field work
Supervised and mentored master's and undergraduate students

work.name: UM-CIMAS, NOAA-AOML
highlights: Synthesized more than a decade of data from the Florida Keys to assess long-term trends in ocean acidification
Led laboratory experiments on how temperature and nutrient enrichment affect stony coral tissue loss disease
Co-led the integration of robotic systems to increase experimental capacity in a wet lab facility
Secured research funding as PI on NOAA and FDEP grants
Published peer-reviewed articles and presented at international conferences

work.name: National Research Council
highlights: Designed and led experiments on the role of nutrient enrichment in white band disease progression in corals
Mentored a master's student in experimental design, data analysis, and scientific writing
Published peer-reviewed articles and presented findings at an international conference
